question: We are preparing to launch assets in extreme weather markets. We've run accelerated aging tests at different ambient temperature levels to simulate these climates. I need AssetsOpsBench to isolate the impact of ambient temperature on the rate of capacity fade. Predict the RUL for the cells tested at high temperatures versus those at room temperature. Give me the comparative RMSE for both groups and plot a comparative degradation curve showing how much faster the high-temp cells hit their end-of-life criteria. This data will dictate our warranty policies in desert climates.
